Reminder Notice of Enquiry

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.nowdate(), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name }}

Employee ID: {{ doc.employee_id }}

Designation: {{ doc.designation }}

Branch Name: {{ doc.branch_name }}

With reference to the Show Cause Notice dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_occurrence_date, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }},

Management had decided to conduct an internal enquiry on {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.date_of_enquiry, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} in order to give you an opportunity to prove your innocence with supporting evidence, if any. However, you have abstained yourself from attending the enquiry on the said date.

In view of the above, Management assumes that due to unforeseen circumstances you were unable to attend the enquiry on the said date. Hence, once again, a final opportunity is being given to attend an enquiry on {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.date_of_2nd_enquiry, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, which has been called and informed to you, and you are requested to be present for the enquiry at {{ doc.place_of_enquiry }}, in accordance with the company’s policies.

The enquiry shall comprise management representatives and witnesses. Failing to attend, the proceedings shall be conducted as Ex-parte, assuming that you have no defence to offer against the alleged charges.

For, Sahayog Multistate Credit Co-operative Society Ltd.

Authorised Signatory
name: Reminder Notice Of Enquiry
